title: Window machine
statement: Define a deterministic machine with three work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states formed from the window-advance machine's states together with two seek-phase components. It is the composition of the window-advance machine with a forward skip on tape $1$ followed by a backward skip on tape $1$, using the specified completed state and running seek phase as the component boundaries.
caveat: The skip and composition operations are not defined in the supplied statement, so their exact transition behavior cannot be stated.
